## Beginning Your Journey on Rapa Nui

Rapa Nui welcomes travellers with ocean air and a sense of how far away the mainland lies. The island's main settlement, Hanga Roa, is the centre of local life: it has accommodation, restaurants and many services for visitors. It is usually the starting point for discovering the island, its Polynesian culture and everyday way of life.

A transfer with a Russian-speaking guide helps you begin your trip without language barriers. The journey is a convenient time to discuss practical arrangements and the order of upcoming excursions. This service covers the transfer; visits to archaeological sites and encounters with the moai form part of a separately selected excursion programme.

This is a good option for anyone who wants to communicate in Russian from their first hours on the island. Pickup and drop-off points are agreed when booking. Rapa Nui is best explored at an unhurried pace, with time to appreciate the ocean, volcanic landscapes and living culture of its small island community.

## Excursion Terms

Price: $83 per person. Discounts may be available for more than one person; contact us to discuss.

After departing Manaus and receiving a safety briefing, you will begin a walking route along a trail with instructors.

At stops along the way, guides explain the forest's natural resources and demonstrate practical skills: obtaining water and fire in an emergency, extracting salt, storing plant resources, making traps and shelters, and preparing lunch in the jungle.

After the excursion, return to Manaus, your hotel or the airport.

The route begins after leaving the city along National Route No. 3. The trek to the lagoon takes approximately 2 hours and passes through subantarctic forest, peat valleys and rivers with beaver dams.

The landscape changes along the way: forest gives way to open peat bogs, then streams and stretches with beaver dams appear again. Mountain slopes surround the lagoon on almost every side. There is a stop here for a packed lunch and a hot drink, followed by a return along the same trail.

The summit offers an almost 360-degree panorama of the southern and western parts of Rio. There is enough room at the viewpoint to rest and have a small picnic. Because of the heat and the route's popularity, it is recommended to set out no later than 09:00.

**Duration:** approximately 4 hours.
